WebResource.Name: dodbl_banner-config
WebResource.Description: Admin-only banner configuration screen. Reads and writes the environmentvariablevalue records for dodbl_BannerEnabled, dodbl_BannerType, dodbl_BannerPosition, and dodbl_ConsentExpiryDays through parent.Xrm.WebApi. Gated to the DoD Banner - Config Admin and System Administrator roles; Dataverse privileges on Environment Variable Value remain the enforcement boundary.
